headlines.title: 4 S&P 500 Dividend Stocks Paying Shareholders More Than Their Free Cash Flow
headlines.summary: A fat yield looks like a gift until the cash behind it runs dry. Four household S&P 500 names are sending shareholders checks bigger than the money coming in, and one test shows which payouts may not survive.

headlines.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Agrees Smartways Logistics Deal For Asia Pacific Healthcare Expansion
headlines.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) agreed to acquire Smartways Logistics to grow its healthcare logistics footprint in the Asia Pacific region. The transaction gives UPS access to time critical pharmaceutical and medical device logistics customers in Australia and New Zealand. Smartways Logistics operates in the Oceania healthcare logistics sector, focusing on specialised distribution for hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies.

headlines.title: UPS Likely to Gain From Smartways Logistics Buyout: More Upside Ahead?
headlines.summary: UPS plans to acquire Smartways Logistics to strengthen its healthcare logistics network across Asia-Pacific, boosting capabilities in time-sensitive shipments.

description: United Parcel Service, Inc., a package delivery and logistics provider, offers transportation and delivery services. It operates through two segments, U.S. Domestic Package and International Package. The U.S. Domestic Package segment offers time-definite delivery services for express letters, documents, packages and palletized freight through air and ground services. The International Package segment provides small package operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Latin America, and Asia. The company offers a range of guaranteed day- and time-definite international transportation services; day-definite services; cross-border ground package delivery; contract-only, e-commerce solutions for non-urgent, and cross-border shipments; and international service for urgent and palletized shipments. It also provides international air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage and insurance, mail services, healthcare logistics, distribution, and post-sales services. United Parcel Service, Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
